G500.def: from «473» and «5547»; an opponent of the Messiah:--antichrist.

G501.et: from antlos (the hold of a ship)
G501.def: from antlos (the hold of a ship); to bale up (properly, bilge water), i.e. dip water (with a bucket, pitcher, etc.):--draw (out).

G502.def: from «501»; a baling-vessel:--thing to draw with.

G503.def: from a compound of «473» and «3788»; to face:--bear up into.

G504.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «5204»; waterless, i.e. dry:--dry, without water.

G505.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of (5271)
G505.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of «5271»; undissembled, i.e. sincere:--without dissimulation (hypocrisy), unfeigned.

G506.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of (5293)
G506.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of «5293»; unsubdued, i.e. insubordinate (in fact or temper):--disobedient, that is not put under, unruly.

G507.def: adverb from «473»; upward or on the top:--above, brim, high, up.

G508.def: from «507» and «1093»; above the ground, i.e. (properly) the second floor of a building; used for a dome or a balcony on the upper story:--upper room.

G509.def: from «507»; from above; by analogy, from the first; by implication, anew:--from above, again, from the beginning (very first), the top.

G511.def: comparative degree of «507»; upper, i.e. (neuter as adverb) to a more conspicuous place, in a former part of the book:--above, higher.

G512.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and the base of (5624)
G512.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and the base of «5624»; useless or (neuter) inutility:--unprofitable(-ness).

G513.def: probably from agnumi (to break; compare «4486»); an axe:--axe.

G514.def: probably from «71»; deserving, comparable or suitable (as if drawing praise):--due reward, meet, (un-)worthy.

G515.def: from «514»; to deem entitled or fit:--desire, think good, count (think) worthy.

G516.def: adverb from «514»; appropriately:--as becometh, after a godly sort, worthily(-thy).

G517.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «3707»; invisible:--invisible (thing).

G518.def: from «575» and the base of «32»; to announce:--bring word (again), declare, report, shew (again), tell.

G519.et: from (575) and agcho (to choke akin to the base of (43))
G519.def: from «575» and agcho (to choke; akin to the base of «43»); to strangle oneself off (i.e. to death):--hang himself.

G520.def: from «575» and «71»; to take off (in various senses):--bring, carry away, lead (away), put to death, take away.

G521.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of (3811)
G521.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a derivative of «3811»; uninstructed, i.e. (figuratively) stupid:--unlearned.

G522.def: from «575» and «142»; to lift off, i.e. remove:--take (away).

G523.pos: 1. to ask back, demand back, exact something due
G523.def: from «575» and «154»; to demand back:--ask again, require.

G524.def: from «575» and algeo (to smart); to grieve out, i.e. become apathetic:--be past feeling.

G525.def: from «575» and «236»; to change away, i.e. release, (reflexively) remove:--deliver, depart.

G526.def: from «575» and a derivative of «245»; to estrange away, i.e. (passively and figuratively) to be non-participant:-- alienate, be alien.

G528.def: from «575» and a derivative of «473»; to meet away, i.e. encounter:--meet.

G530.def: probably from «537»; one (or a single) time (numerically or conclusively):--once.

G531.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of (3845)
G531.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a derivative of «3845»; not passing away, i.e. untransferable (perpetual):-- unchangeable.

G532.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of (3903)
G532.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a derivative of «3903»; unready:--unprepared.

G533.def: from «575» and «720»; to deny utterly, i.e. disown, abstain:--deny.

G534.def: from «575» and «737»; from now, i.e. henceforth (already):--from henceforth.

G536.def: from a compound of «575» and «756»; a beginning of sacrifice, i.e. the (Jewish) first-fruit (figuratively):--first-fruits.

G537.et: from (1) (as a particle of union) and (3956)
G537.def: from «1» (as a particle of union) and «3956»; absolutely all or (singular) every one:--all (things), every (one), whole.

G538.def: of uncertain derivation; to cheat, i.e. delude:--deceive.

G540.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «3962»; fatherless, i.e. of unrecorded paternity:--without father.

G541.def: from a compound of «575» and «826»; an off-flash, i.e. effulgence:--brightness.

G542.def: from «575» and the same as «1492»; to see fully:--see.

G544.def: from «545»; to disbelieve (wilfully and perversely):--not believe, disobedient, obey not, unbelieving.

G545.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «3982»; unpersuadable, i.e. contumacious:--disobedient.

G546.def: of uncertain derivation; to menace; by implication, to forbid:--threaten.

G548.def: from «575» and «1510»; to be away:--be absent. Compare «549».

G549.def: from «575» and eimi (to go); to go away:--go. Compare «548».

G550.et: reflexive past of a compound of (575) and (2036)
G550.def: reflexive past of a compound of «575» and «2036»; to say off for oneself, i.e. disown:--renounce.

G551.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of (3987)
G551.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of «3987»; untried, i.e. not temptable:--not to be tempted.

G552.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «3984»; inexperienced, i.e. ignorant:--unskilful.

G553.def: from «575» and «1551»; to expect fully:--look (wait) foreign

G554.def: middle voice from «575» and «1562»; to divest wholly oneself, or (for oneself) despoil:--put off, spoil.

G557.def: from a compound of «575» and «1651»; refutation, i.e. (by implication) contempt:--nought.

G558.def: from «575» and «1658»; one freed away, i.e. a freedman:--freeman.

G559.def: of Latin origin; Apelles, a Christian:--Apelles.

G560.def: from «575» and «1679»; to hope out, i.e. fully expect:--hope for again.

G561.def: from «575» and «1725»; from in front, i.e. opposite, before or against:--before, contrary, over against, in the presence of.

G562.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a secondary derivative of (4008)
G562.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a secondary derivative of «4008»; unfinished, i.e. (by implication) interminable:--endless.

G563.et: from a compound of (1) (as a negative participle) and a presumed derivative of (4049)
G563.def: adverb from a compound of «1» (as a negative participle) and a presumed derivative of «4049»; undistractedly, i.e. free from (domestic) solicitude:--without distraction.

G564.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of (4059)
G564.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of «4059»; uncircumcised (figuratively):--uncircumcised.

G565.def: from «575» and «2064»; to go off (i.e. depart), aside (i.e. apart) or behind (i.e. follow), literally or figuratively:--come, depart, go (aside, away, back, out, ... ways), pass away, be past.

G566.et: third person singular present indicative active of (568) used impersonally
G566.def: third person singular present indicative active of «568» used impersonally; it is sufficient:--it is enough.

G567.def: middle voice (reflexively) of «568»; to hold oneself off, i.e. refrain:--abstain.

G568.def: from «575» and «2192»; (actively) to have out, i.e. receive in full; (intransitively) to keep (oneself) away, i.e. be distant (literally or figuratively):--be, have, receive.

G569.def: from «571»; to be unbelieving, i.e. (transitively) disbelieve, or (by implication) disobey:--believe not.

G570.def: from «571»; faithlessness, i.e. (negatively) disbelief (lack of Christian faith), or (positively) unfaithfulness (disobedience):--unbelief.

G571.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «4103»; (actively) disbelieving, i.e. without Christian faith (specially, a heathen); (passively) untrustworthy (person), or incredible (thing):--that believeth not, faithless, incredible thing, infidel, unbeliever(-ing).

G572.def: from «573»; singleness, i.e. (subjectively) sincerity (without dissimulation or self-seeking), or (objectively) generosity (copious bestowal):--bountifulness, liberal(-ity), simplicity, singleness.

G573.et: probably from (1) (as a particle of union) and the base of (4120)
G573.def: probably from «1» (as a particle of union) and the base of «4120»; properly, folded together, i.e. single (figuratively, clear):--single.

G574.def: adverb from «573» (in the objective sense of «572»); bountifully; --liberally.

G575.pos:
1. of separation
    1. of local separation, after verbs of motion from a place i.e. of departing, of fleeing, ...
    2. of separation of a part from the whole
      1. where of a whole some part is taken
    3. of any kind of separation of one thing from another by which the union or fellowship of the two is destroyed
    4. of a state of separation, that is of distance
      1. physical, of distance of place
      2. temporal, of distance of time
  2. of origin
    1. of the place whence anything is, comes, befalls, is taken
    2. of origin of a cause
G575.def: a primary particle; "off," i.e. away (from something near), in various senses (of place, time, or relation; literal or figurative):--(X here-)after, ago, at, because of, before, by (the space of), for(-th), from, in, (out) of, off, (up-)on(-ce), since, with. In composition (as a prefix) it usually denotes separation, departure, cessation, completion, reversal, etc.

G576.def: from «575» and the base of «939»; literally, to disembark; figuratively, to eventuate:--become, go out, turn.

G577.def: from «575» and «906»; to throw off; figuratively, to lose:--cast away.

G578.def: from «575» and «991»; to look away from everything else, i.e. (figuratively) intently regard:--have respect.

G579.def: from «577»; cast off, i.e. (figuratively) such as to be rejected:--be refused.

G580.pos:
1. rejection, repudiation
    1. to throw away from one's self, cast off, repudiate
  2. a losing, a loss
G580.def: from «577»; rejection; figuratively, loss:--casting away, loss.

G581.et: past participle of a compound of (575) and (1096)
G581.def: past participle of a compound of «575» and «1096»; absent, i.e. deceased (figuratively, renounced):--being dead.

G582.def: from «583»; an enrollment; by implication, an assessment:--taxing.

G583.def: from «575» and «1125»; to write off (a copy or list), i.e. enrol:--tax, write.

G584.def: from «575» and «1166»; to show off, i.e. exhibit; figuratively, to demonstrate, i.e. accredit:--(ap-)prove, set forth, shew.

G586.def: from «575» and «1183»; to tithe (as debtor or creditor):--(give, pay, take) tithe.

G588.def: from «575» and «1209»; to take fully, i.e. welcome (persons), approve (things):--accept, receive (gladly).

G589.def: from «590»; to go abroad, i.e. visit a foreign land:--go (travel) into a far country, journey.

G590.def: from «575» and «1218»; absent from one's own people, i.e. a foreign traveller:--taking a far journey.

G591.def: from «575» and «1325»; to give away, i.e. up, over, back, etc. (in various applications):--deliver (again), give (again), (re-)pay(-ment be made), perform, recompense, render, requite, restore, reward, sell, yield.

G592.et: from (575) and a compound of (223) and (3724)
G592.def: from «575» and a compound of «223» and «3724»; to disjoin (by a boundary, figuratively, a party):--separate.

G593.def: from «575» and «1381»; to disapprove, i.e. (by implication) to repudiate:--disallow, reject.

G595.def: from «659»; a laying aside (literally or figuratively):--putting away (off).

G596.def: from «659»; a repository, i.e. granary:--barn, garner.

G597.def: from «575» and «2343»; to treasure away:--lay up in store.

G598.def: from «575» and «2346»; to crowd (from every side):--press.

G599.def: from «575» and «2348»; to die off (literally or figuratively):--be dead, death, die, lie a-dying, be slain (X with).
